title: Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors: descriptive metadata for custom connectors and their schema properties
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Graph operations, permissions and licensing statements are supported. It distinguishes documented metadata from planned capabilities and correctly qualifies the default category as applying when no category is supplied.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans descriptive metadata that gives Copilot more context about custom connections and their schema properties.
claims.quote: We’re introducing new options that allow admins and developers to enrich their custom Copilot connectors and its schema properties with descriptive metadata.

claims.claim: The roadmap includes alternate names for connectors.
claims.quote: Add alternate names, data source categories, common actions to your connector and description for schema properties.

claims.claim: The roadmap includes data source categories for connectors.
claims.quote: Add alternate names, data source categories, common actions to your connector and description for schema properties.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The roadmap includes common actions as connector metadata.
claims.quote: Add alternate names, data source categories, common actions to your connector and description for schema properties.

claims.claim: The roadmap includes descriptions for schema properties.
claims.quote: Add alternate names, data source categories, common actions to your connector and description for schema properties.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2025.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2025"

claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Targeted Release"]

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The externalConnection contentCategory property identifies the content domain and aids relevance and query interpretation.
claims.quote: This property helps Microsoft Graph optimize relevance, ranking, and semantic understanding by signaling the nature of the ingested content.

claims.claim: contentCategory permits knowledgeBase, wikis, crm, qna and taskManagement.
claims.quote: Possible values are: uncategorized, knowledgeBase, wikis, fileRepository, qna, crm, dashboard, people, media, email, messaging, meetingTranscripts, taskManagement, learningManagement, unknownFutureValue.

claims.claim: contentCategory is optional.
claims.quote: Optional. The default value is uncategorized.

claims.claim: When no category is supplied, contentCategory defaults to uncategorized.
claims.quote: Optional. The default value is uncategorized.

claims.claim: Schema property descriptions are optional.
claims.quote: Optional but we recommend that you use this property for queryable properties.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure and Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: A schema property's description helps Copilot interpret queries and map them to properties.
claims.quote: This property enhances semantic understanding by helping Copilot interpret queries and accurately map them to properties that results in more relevant and precise responses.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[1].note; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A schema property description supports at most 200 characters.
claims.quote: The maximum supported length is 200 characters.

claims.claim: Descriptions on people-data properties with person* labels are ignored.
claims.quote: When you define the schema, provide a human-readable description for each custom property. Descriptions on properties with person* labels are ignored.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no dedicated connector-level alternate-names property.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors metadata enrichment alternate names common actions externalConnection properties Graph. Opened externalConnection v1.0 and beta property tables and Enhance Copilot discovery; aliases belong to schema properties, not connections.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not document the roadmap's connector common-actions metadata or its behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors metadata enrichment alternate names common actions externalConnection properties Graph. Opened externalConnection v1.0 and beta, connectors API overview and discovery guidance; no connector common-actions metadata property is documented.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends including alternative names in the connection description.
claims.quote: Alternative names for the connection that users might be familiar with.

claims.claim: The Graph history lists contentCategory as added in February 2026 under New and generally available.
claims.quote:
February 2026: New and generally available
Added the contentCategory property to the externalConnection to specify the domain category of the content associated with the external connection for improved relevance and ranking.

claims.claim: Connection descriptions help Copilot match connector content to user requests.
claims.quote: Choose a meaningful connection name and description to help Copilot better match the connector content to the user's request.

claims.claim: Connectors carrying people data must set contentCategory to people.
claims.quote: Copilot connectors that contain people data must have the value people in the contentCategory property of the externalConnections API.

claims.claim: Connection descriptions are optional and need not be changed.
claims.quote: Description of the connection displayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Optional.

claims.claim: The metadata is an optional developer-chosen capability, classified as user-opt-in, rather than a required rollout task.
claims.quote: contentCategory: Optional. The default value is uncategorized. description: Optional. Searched: Copilot custom connectors metadata enrichment tenant admin enable disable switch description schema property admin center edit; no enrichment enablement switch found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether schema property descriptions can appear in user-facing answers or citations.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors schema property description visible users answers citations. Opened property resource, people-data connector guidance and schema management guide; passages about retrieved property values do not specify exposure of schema descriptions.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: Updating a connection requires ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy or ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote:
Delegated (work or school account) | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All
Application | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All

claims.claim: Updating a schema requires ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy or ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote:
Delegated (work or school account) | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All
Application | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.OwnedBy | ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/external/connections/{connectionsId} updates an existing connection description through the description body property.
claims.quote:
PATCH /external/connections/{connectionsId}
The following properties can be updated.
description | String | Description of the connection displayed in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/external/connections/contosohr

claims.claim: An admin UI for editing an existing custom Graph connection's description is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connector schema property description edit Microsoft 365 admin center user interface. Opened Manage connector connections and Enhance Copilot discovery; UI editing is described for Microsoft and partner connectors, not explicitly custom Graph connections.

claims.where: controls[1].api; controls[1].note; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/external/connections/{id}/schema sets schema property descriptions in the properties collection.
claims.quote:
Create a new or update an existing schema.
PATCH /external/connections/{id}/schema
In the request body, supply a JSON representation of a schema object.
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/external/connections/contosohr/schema

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no admin UI for descriptions of custom connection schema properties.
claims.quote: Searched: custom Copilot connector schema property description edit Microsoft 365 admin center user interface. Opened Manage connector connections and Register and manage schema; found custom schema recommendations and Graph property definitions, not a description-editing UI.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant-wide UI or API switch specifically enabling or disabling connector metadata enrichment.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot custom connectors metadata enrichment tenant admin enable disable switch description schema property admin center edit. Opened Manage connector connections, externalConnection v1.0/beta and API overview; connection visibility is not an enrichment switch.

claims.claim: The documented metadata is managed on individual connections by authorized developers or managing applications.
claims.quote:
PATCH /external/connections/{connectionsId}
configuration: Specifies additional application IDs that are allowed to manage the connection and to index content in the connection.

claims.claim: The schema operation can take between 5 and 15 minutes for creation.
claims.quote: It can take between 5 and 15 minutes for the schema to be created.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Connector grounding entitlement is included with Microsoft 365 Copilot licences.
claims.quote: If your organization has Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, connector grounding in Copilot is included, and no extra charges apply.

claims.claim: The prerequisites page states that no extra charges apply for connector grounding with Microsoft 365 Copilot licences.
claims.quote: If your organization has Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, connector grounding in Copilot is included, and no extra charges apply.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter
claims.claim: Indexing synced connector data incurs no extra cost for tenants with Microsoft 365 licences.
claims.quote: Indexing of synced connector data incurs no extra cost for tenants with Microsoft 365 licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 plus the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on supports synced connector grounding.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 + Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on | ✅ | ✅ | ✅

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 E7 is an alternative licence supporting synced connector grounding.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅

claims.claim: The Copilot Studio licensing option supports agents rather than Copilot grounding for synced connectors.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 + Copilot Studio license | ✅ | Agents only (no Copilot grounding) | ❌

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot pay-as-you-go supports agents rather than Copilot grounding for synced connectors.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no licence specific to the metadata, including alternate names or common actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors metadata enrichment contentCategory description licensing pricing meter charge. Opened connector prerequisites, externalConnection and property references; product licensing is stated, but no metadata-specific entitlement is published.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate meter or charge for the metadata, including alternate names or common actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot connectors metadata enrichment contentCategory description licensing pricing meter charge. Read connector prerequisites and search results for Copilot pay-as-you-go meters; neither states a metadata editing meter or charge.

claims.claim: Custom Copilot connectors are built using the Microsoft Graph connectors REST API.
claims.quote: To build custom connectors, you use the Copilot connectors REST API.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents editing Microsoft-built connector names and descriptions in the admin centre.
claims.quote: You can modify the connection name and description for Microsoft-built connectors in the admin portal at any time to reflect updates or changes to the content.

claims.claim: The admin centre's supported-operations table lists name and description editing for partner connectors.
claims.quote: Edit a published connection | ✔️ Name and description ✔️ Connection settings ✔️ Property labels ✔️ Schema ✔️ Refresh schedule ✔️ Query string (ServiceNow) ✔️ Advanced criteria (ServiceNow) ✔️ User mapping (ServiceNow) | ✔️ Name ✔️ Description

claims.claim: That supported-operations table does not have a separate custom-connector column.
claims.quote: Operation | Connectors by Microsoft | Connectors by partners

claims.claim: Managing connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center requires the AI administrator role.
claims.quote: To access and manage your Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors, you must be an AI administrator for your organization.

claims.claim: A connection schema must be registered before items are ingested.
claims.quote: You must register the schema before ingesting items into Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: A custom connection schema supports up to 128 properties.
claims.quote: The properties object must contain at least one property, up to a maximum of 128.

claims.claim: Microsoft's connection-description guidance recommends content type, scope and keywords.
claims.quote:
A brief overview of the content type.
The scope of the content available within the connection.
Keywords that users might use to find the content (for example, tickets, wiki, knowledge base, How to).

claims.claim: Microsoft directs updates to on-premises connector descriptions to the connectors API.
claims.quote: To update descriptions for on-premises connectors, use the Copilot connectors API.

claims.claim: The connection-update reference lists configuration, description and name as updatable, but does not list contentCategory.
claims.quote:
The following properties can be updated.
configuration | microsoft.graph.externalConnectors.configuration
description | String
name | String
